faq_heading: Sullivan Heights condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Sullivan Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sullivan Heights, Burnaby: 60 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 7 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Sullivan Heights was little changed, 60 in June and 60 in October (+0.0%), and 53 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.6% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Sullivan Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

97 condos sold in Sullivan Heights with a median price of $567,500 (the middle half sold between $503,000 and $685,000), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $818 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $449 a month. 8 townhomes sold in Sullivan Heights with a median price of $1,044,000 (the middle half sold between $782,750 and $1,096,500), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $756 per square foot, a median year built of 2004 and a median strata fee of $434 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 60 condos and townhomes listed in Sullivan Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Sullivan Heights had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 53 condos and townhomes sold in Sullivan Heights over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Sullivan Heights sell for?
faq.a: 97 condos sold in Sullivan Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $567,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
